presets.name: Bare
presets.summary: No hat, glasses, beard or accessory.
presets.description: Four optional components switched off at once. On a 16 by 16 grid an accessory costs a lot of the pixels available, so the plain face reads better at small sizes.

presets.name: Sepia
presets.summary: Brown throughout, skin and clothes included.
presets.description: Eight color groups all moved onto one warm ramp. Leaving the skin palette out would keep a natural face in the middle of a monochrome avatar, which is worse than doing nothing.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.summary: No hue on any of the eight groups.
presets.description: For a print stylesheet, a disabled state, or anywhere color already carries meaning. Pixel art holds up well here because the shapes are the identity, not the palette.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.summary: One blue, one cream, nothing else.
presets.description: Two colors across the whole avatar. A row of these reads as one set, and only the haircut and expression tell them apart.

presets.name: Muted
presets.summary: Dusty clothes and hair, skin untouched.
presets.description: The style dresses everyone in twelve saturated colors and ships lime and pillar-box red among the hair. Both move to tones that sit quietly, which helps when a table shows thirty avatars at once. Skin keeps its own palette.

presets.name: Electric
presets.summary: Clothes past anything the style ships.
presets.description: The same group pulled the other way, and only that group. Loud clothes under loud hair would cancel out, so the hair keeps the palette it was born with.

presets.name: Pastel Wall
presets.summary: A soft ground behind the sprite.
presets.description: The style ships no background at all, so an avatar sits on whatever is behind it. Six pale colors give it a tile of its own without pulling attention off the face.

presets.name: Bold Pop
presets.description: The sprites are small and high contrast, so they hold their own against a saturated ground rather than dissolving into it.

presets.name: Night Shift
presets.summary: Near-black ground, pale hair and clothes.
presets.description: For dark interfaces. Hair and clothing move to light tones, because the style's default dark browns and navies vanish against a dark tile.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.summary: A warm gradient behind the sprite.
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle. Both stops stay light so the dark outline of the sprite keeps its edge.
